note.en: A standard 1.8 m adult, used as a reference figure

Length: 40 ft (12.2 m), the maximum length allowed for a school bus in Pennsylvania (67 Pa. Code § 171.63); some states allow up to 45 ft. Height: 128 in (3.25 m), the top of the 122–128 in overall height Blue Bird gives for its full-size Vision Diesel bus.
